events.description: Spun out of full-sweep audit on 2026-05-19 (H5 + H6 + H7). Iconoclast unreachable due to L4 requirement, wrong pop, missing Veilsteel; Scholar cost trivially low; no singleton cap.

events.title: Stat / cost fixes
events.description: Feraldis_Iconoclast: minBuildingLevel 4->3 (reachable at Temple L3), cost adds Veilsteel 30. Iconoclast.cs PopulationCost.Amount 4->1. Alanthor_Scholar: minBuildingLevel 4->3, cost raised from 120 S + 30 C to 300 S + 150 I + 100 C + 30 Vs to match game-ender tier (per task R4).

Phase 2 (FactionUnitLimitSystem singleton cap) deferred: needs a new ECS system that checks alive+queued unit count per faction before training accepts the request, plus a UI toast path through HudBridge. Recommend pairing with task-063 phase 2 since religious units now route to Temple-hosted training.
